d:
The UN appointed Independent International Commission of Enquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory has stated in its report to the UN General Assembly that Israel has continued to commit war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocidal crimes against Palestinians even after the October 2025 Kaza ceasefire. The Commission in its latest report has details about the continuing systemic violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
Guest: Justice Srinivasan Muralidhar, Chair, Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
